name: Idle Hands Are The Devils Playground
overview: Scripture warns that idleness leads to spiritual and practical ruin, as seen in Proverbs where the sluggard is admonished to learn diligence from the ant and warned that slothfulness brings poverty and hunger. The diligent are promised authority and profit, while the lazy are likened to wasteful and ungodly individuals who stir up evil. Thus, idle hands become a fertile ground for destructive behavior, emphasizing the need for faithful, active labor as a safeguard against temptation and moral decay.
